description: This Kotlin source file defines a UI component for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It manages the tabbed navigation interface in the post-onboarding section, including different tabs like Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings. The file handles state management for active tabs, connection status, and navigation, and it renders various UI components such as top status bar, bottom tab bar, and associated content screens.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: An enum representing the different tabs in the home screen: Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings.

classes.name: StatusVisual
classes.description: An enum representing different visual statuses like Connected, Connecting, Warning, Error, and Offline.

methods.name: PostOnboardingTabs
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the tabbed UI, managing state transitions, and handling navigation.

methods.name: ScreenTabScreen
methods.description: Composable rendering the screen tab content, with connection status refresh logic.

methods.name: TopStatusBar
methods.description: Displays a top bar with connection status information.

methods.name: BottomTabBar
methods.description: Displays a bottom navigation bar with tab icons and labels.
